title: Prove a uniform cyclic root-lifting obstruction with dirty helpers
body:
PR2187 leaves C8 root lifting open after its four-output C4 obstruction. This package proves uniformly that t nonidentity diagonal outputs over F2[C_(2^k)] require at least t rank-one increment factors, even with any number of restored dirty helpers. A column-factorization and chain-ring socle argument replaces finite word search; unrestricted-power coordinate calls attain the lower bound.

The theorem is written, not proof-assistant verified. Two independent exact finite engines agree on 69,632 exhaustive small matrices and 768 rectangular samples; four mixed-power constructions, 24 telescoping cases and five semantic controls pass. The C2 x C2 one-column/two-socle-direction control demonstrates why this proof does not generalize to every group algebra. No native supplier, rational-frame conversion, actual power tariff or new kappa is claimed.

CPython3.12.14 registered optimized replay, Git-free relocation and three actual source/receipt/algorithm corruption checks pass. A separate AI proof reviewer found no actionable issue. No hosted CI or human-review pass is claimed.

Current main 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2, priority revision4; picker seed c9a17e1c87a19c1899f44b815ee535a7, bit-new-register-model, explicit scope change to PR2187 C8 handoff. Only research/bit-cyclic-root-barrier is added. Credit Cinna Davis (@1337isnot1337) for PR2187 (exact head/model retained), and main source authors for context. New work prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.

Final overlap: 710 open PRs and 1,207 Discussion records, complete pagination and no warnings (13:14-13:17 UTC); exact mechanism terms still found only PR2187/Discussion2185.
